_doc: Fixtures: things that stand in or on a tile without changing what the tile is (src/decor.py; Dungeon Alive 2026-11-12). The picture is assets/tiles/env/fixtures/<id>.png, drawn over the tile; without one, a blocking fixture is drawn as a plain block in 'color' and a decal is not drawn. 'layer': floor (a flat decal on a walkable tile), stand (an object on a floor tile), wall (hung on or cut into a wall tile). 'blocks': nothing can walk through it. 'opaque': it blocks sight like a pillar. 'look': what Observe (O) says. 'name': what a bump says stands in the way. 'spent_look': what Observe says once a lore fixture is spent, when it differs.

labrys_mark.name: a double-axe carving
labrys_mark.look: A double axe cut into the stone and filled with old red paint. The Minoans of Crete carved this sign again and again; some scholars think it gave the labyrinth its name.

bull_fresco.name: a bull fresco
bull_fresco.look: A faded painting of a red bull, and a youth leaping over its horns. The Minoans painted bull-leapers on their palace walls.

horns_consecration.name: stone horns
horns_consecration.look: Two stone horns on a base: the Minoans' horns of consecration, set up where something sacred once stood.

bone_pile.name: old bones
bone_pile.look: Old bones. Whoever they were, they came this far.

rubble.name: rubble
rubble.look: Stones fallen from the ceiling. Not recently, you hope.

wall_torch.name: a torch
wall_torch.look: A torch in an iron sconce, still burning. Somebody keeps these lit.

cobweb.name: a cobweb
cobweb.look: A curtain of old web. Whatever spun it was either very large or very patient.

broken_pot.name: a broken jar
broken_pot.look: A smashed storage jar. Grain once, by the husks.

statue_shield.name: a statue
statue_shield.look: A warrior in stone, his shield raised before his face. He saw it coming. It did not help.

statue_stride.name: a statue
statue_stride.look: A man in stone, caught mid-stride, looking back over his shoulder.

statue_kneel.name: a statue
statue_kneel.look: A kneeling man in stone with one arm thrown across his eyes. Too late.

statue_reach.name: a statue
statue_reach.look: A woman in stone, one hand reaching out, her mouth open on a word nobody heard.

statue_spear.name: a statue
statue_spear.look: A spearman in stone. Moss has grown up over his greaves.

column_drum.name: a fallen column
column_drum.look: A fallen drum from a fluted marble column. The roof it held up is somewhere else now.

ivy.name: ivy
ivy.look: Ivy, thick and dark, where no sun has ever reached.

roots.name: roots
roots.look: Pale roots pushing up between the slabs, from something growing far above.

snake_skin.name: a snake skin
snake_skin.look: A shed snake skin, longer than you are tall.

olive_leaves.name: olive leaves
olive_leaves.look: Dry olive leaves, blown in from nowhere. The olive was Athena's tree.

offering_basin.name: an offering basin
offering_basin.look: A marble basin for offerings, long dry.

statue_rubble.name: broken statues
statue_rubble.look: A stone hand, a stone head, broken off something that was once a person.

stalagmite.name: a stalagmite
stalagmite.look: A stalagmite, black with old soot.

slayer_bones.name: a burned skeleton
slayer_bones.look: A skeleton with a split shield and a snapped sword, burned where it fell.

scorch_mark.name: a scorch mark
scorch_mark.look: A black scorch on the stone, splashed outward. Something breathed here.

ember_crack.name: a glowing crack
ember_crack.look: A crack in the rock, glowing with heat from somewhere far below.

ash_drift.name: ash
ash_drift.look: Grey ash, drifted against the stone like snow.

crystal_cluster.name: red crystals
crystal_cluster.look: Dull red crystals growing out of the rock, warm to the touch.

pick_and_cart.name: a mining cart
pick_and_cart.look: A dwarf-made mining cart with a pick leaning on it. Whoever dug here left in a hurry.

frozen_warrior.name: a frozen warrior
frozen_warrior.look: A warrior frozen inside a pillar of ice, his axe still raised.

rune_stone.name: a runestone
rune_stone.look: A runestone. The runes run along the body of a carved serpent, as on the old stones of the north.

mead_bench.name: a bench
mead_bench.look: A long mead-hall bench with a drinking horn on it, frozen to the wood.

shield_wall.name: shields
shield_wall.look: Round shields hung along the wall, as in a hall of the north.

broken_fetter.name: a broken fetter
broken_fetter.look: A shackle as wide as a cartwheel, and a few links of broken chain.

brazier_cold.name: a brazier
brazier_cold.look: An iron brazier full of dead coals. Lit, it would melt the ice round it.

smoke_vent.name: a smoking crack
smoke_vent.look: A crack in the glass, with smoke rising out of it. On the floor of the Pit, the locusts climb out of these.
smoke_vent.spent_look: Smoke still rises from the crack. Whatever you said over it was not enough.

hanging_chains.name: chains
hanging_chains.look: Chains hang down the wall, with hooks on the ends.

bone_spire.name: a bone spire
bone_spire.look: A spire of black bones, fused together by heat.

brimstone.name: brimstone
brimstone.look: Bubbling yellow sulphur. It would burn straight through your boots.

glow_fissure.name: a glowing fissure
glow_fissure.look: A wide crack glowing deep red.

seal_stone.name: a seal stone
seal_stone.look: A black standing stone stamped with a red seal.

ruined_throne.name: a broken throne
ruined_throne.look: A black stone throne, split down the back.

fallen_star.name: a fallen star
fallen_star.look: A lump of black and silver rock, still white-hot in its cracks. A star fell here.

bronze_grate.name: a bronze grate
bronze_grate.look: A bronze grate, its bars thick as a man's wrist.

statue_crowd.name: a crowd of statues
statue_crowd.look: Statues packed shoulder to shoulder, every one of them looking back.

fire_curtain.name: a curtain of fire
fire_curtain.look: A sheet of fire that burns on nothing at all.

fire_out.name: dead embers
fire_out.look: A line of dying embers where the fire stood.

snow_barrier.name: a wall of snow
snow_barrier.look: Snow packed hard, colder than snow should be. It does not melt.

snow_slush.name: slush
snow_slush.look: Grey slush, all that is left of the drift.

wax_seal.name: a great seal
wax_seal.look: A seal of red wax as wide as a door, stamped with a horned sign.

wax_seal_broken.name: a broken seal
wax_seal_broken.look: The great seal, broken in three.

bunk.name: a bunk
bunk.look: A rough bunk with a grey blanket.

weapon_rack.name: a weapon rack
weapon_rack.look: A rack of old spears and a sword, rusted to the wood.

cook_pot.name: a cook-pot
cook_pot.look: A cold cook-pot hanging over dead ashes.

bookshelf.name: a bookshelf
bookshelf.look: Shelves crammed with scroll-cases and old books.

reading_desk.name: a lectern
reading_desk.look: A lectern with a great book open on it.

strongbox_empty.name: an empty strongbox
strongbox_empty.look: A strongbox, broken open and empty.

ledger_desk.name: a clerk's desk
ledger_desk.look: A clerk's desk: a ledger, an inkpot, a little set of coin scales.

candles.name: candles
candles.look: Candles, still burning. Somebody lit them.

icon.name: an icon
icon.look: A painted icon in gold and red: a robed figure with a halo.

straw.name: straw
straw.look: Trampled straw, and the smell of things that sleep on it.

cage.name: a cage
cage.look: An iron cage, its door hanging open.

feed_trough.name: a trough
feed_trough.look: A feed trough with a little old grain in it.

grave_marker.name: a grave marker
grave_marker.look: A grave marker, leaning. The name has worn away.

banner.name: a banner
banner.look: A red banner with a faded gold crown.

copyist_desk.name: a copyist's desk
copyist_desk.look: A scribe's desk with a half-copied page.

alchemist_bench.name: an alchemist's bench
alchemist_bench.look: An alchemist's bench: a glass retort, flasks, a burner gone cold.

surveyor_table.name: a surveyor's table
surveyor_table.look: A table with a half-drawn map pinned flat.

memorial_stone.name: a memorial stone
memorial_stone.look: A stone cut with rows of names.

wayside_icon.name: a wayside shrine
wayside_icon.look: A little roofed shrine on a post, with a painted icon and a candle.

trophy_board.name: a trophy board
trophy_board.look: A hunter's board: antlers, tusks, a small skull.

brazen_head.name: a brazen head
brazen_head.look: A bronze head on a stone plinth, with eyes of glass.

riddle_lintel.name: a carved lintel
riddle_lintel.look: A lintel carved with an owl and a line of writing.

gamblers_table.name: a gaming table
gamblers_table.look: A rough table with cards, dice and a little heap of copper.

field_kitchen.name: a cooking fire
field_kitchen.look: A camp fire with a pot on a tripod, a ladle and a sack of vegetables.

fire_vent.name: a vent
fire_vent.look: An iron-ringed vent in the floor, glowing deep inside. It breathes fire on a beat, and it glows white the turn before. Watch it once and you will know when to cross.

fire_vent_active.name: a jet of fire
fire_vent_active.look: Fire roars up out of the vent. Wait for it.

thin_ice.name: thin ice
thin_ice.look: Thin, cracked ice over black water. It might hold you. It would not hold you and a heavy pack.

crumbling_floor.name: cracked flagstones
crumbling_floor.look: Cracked flagstones, sagging, with darkness in the gaps. They will not take much weight.

strangler_vine.name: thorny vines
strangler_vine.look: Thick thorny vines across the floor. Some of them are moving. Whatever walks through them gets held.

soul_sigil.name: a burned sigil
soul_sigil.look: A ring of sigils burned into the glass. It drinks the magic of whoever stands on it.

icicle_shadow.name: broken ice
icicle_shadow.look: Shards of broken ice under a ceiling bristling with icicles. Something fell here, and more are hanging.

campfire.name: a campfire
campfire.look: A campfire in a ring of stones, still burning.

banner_goblin.name: a goblin banner
banner_goblin.look: A ragged hide on a pole, a red hand painted on it, bones hanging off it.

banner_bandit.name: a bandit standard
banner_bandit.look: A torn black cloth with a white skull, on a spear.

banner_cult.name: a cult standard
banner_cult.look: A black cloth with a red horned sign, on a pole topped by a skull.

banner_giant.name: a giant's standard
banner_giant.look: A whole tree for a pole, with a bear pelt and antlers lashed to it.

banner_fae.name: a fair-folk pennant
banner_fae.look: Silver-green silk on a slender white pole, with thorns twined round it.

banner_dead.name: a necromancer's standard
banner_dead.look: A rotted grey cloth with a black hand, on a pole of bone.
